zoe: Quick check-in 1: I drafted a compact manager + HR onboarding checklist for the IC starting Mon. Goal: make Day 1 frictionless and have measurable 30/60/90 milestones. Please review and flag gaps.

marcus: Looks good. I'll schedule Day 1 1:1 and assign a buddy. Plan to give a small "first ticket" that exercises CI + local dev run.

zoe: Copy of the checklist (paste for managers):
```
Pre-start (48-72h):
- Hardware order placed or confirmed (IT)
- SSO + Slack invite completed
- Access requested to repos + CI project
- Calendar holds ready: intro, manager 1:1 (weekly), team sync, onboarding walkthroughs

Day 1 (first 8h):
- 9:00 intro w/ People Ops (paperwork + benefits brief)
- 10:00 dev environment setup w/ DevEx (pair remote setup)
- 11:00 team round-robin intros (15m each)
- Lunch w/ buddy
- 14:00 small starter task assigned (make a tiny fix + open PR)
- End of day: 30-min check-in w/ manager (clarify goals + expectations)

Week 1:
- Cross-team intros: Product, SRE, Security, Support
- Product walkthrough: metrics + roadmap (30m)
- CI/CD and PR workflow review
- Complete smoke tests and one green PR merged

30/60/90 (concrete examples):
- 30d: run local stack, ship first bugfix or infra tweak, 2 PRs merged, attend on-call walkthrough
- 60d: take ownership of a small feature area, improve test coverage by X%, reduce template latency or flake rate
- 90d: lead a rollout or demo, document decisions, propose next-quarter work
```

zoe: Owners: People Ops (paperwork + benefits), IT (hardware + accounts), DevEx (env + repo access), Manager (mentor + goals), Security (data access). Add role-specific tasks and deadlines.

it-bot: IT ticket #5721 created for tom.lee 1: standard laptop + VPN + SSO. ETA: 48 hours.

tom.lee: Thanks! Two quick Qs: 1) Who grants access to the customer sandbox? 2) What's the preferred way to request temporary elevated creds for experiments?

security: @tom.lee For sandbox access we need manager approval + brief justification. Submit internal form: https://internal.redwood.dev/sec/request-access and cc your manager. Temp creds are 4-hour tokens via Vault with an approval flow - DM me if urgent.

devex: Adding onboarding repo + README: git.internal/redwood/onboarding-template and https://internal.redwood.dev/devex/onboard-guide. We'll do a screenshare to finish env if IT delays hardware.

marcus: For measurable 30/60/90 goals, I'm thinking: 30d = merge 2 PRs and close one onboarding ticket; 60d = own a customer-facing bugfix rollout reducing error rate by 10%; 90d = lead a cross-team postmortem or demo. I'll align these in week-1 1:1.

zoe: I uploaded a short 30/60/90 template for managers: /hr/templates/30-60-90-compact.md (use metrics and acceptance criteria). Please set explicit acceptance criteria in the 1:1.

it-bot: Update: IT ticket #5721 -> hardware shipped. Tracking: 2 business days.

tom.lee: One more: is there a standard onboarding checklist for mentors? Want to make sure buddy knows responsibilities.

zoe: Yep 1: mentor checklist: introduce team, review first task, be available for 1hr/day Week 1, review PRs promptly, run lunch intro. I'll DM the mentor template to @marcus.

marcus: Got it. I'll nominate @sasha as buddy and add the mentor checklist to their calendar.

zoe: Great, thanks everyone. I'll close the loop after IT confirms completion and I'll push final invites. :white_check_mark:

devex: If any env fails, ping me and I'll spawn a dev container so they can start coding immediately.

security: I'll prepare the sandbox onboarding checklist and NDA template and share with People Ops.

tom.lee: Appreciate the speed. Looking forward to Monday! :wave:
